name: Instinct
maker: Instinct (Spear Street Technology Inc.; CEO Noah Shinn)
note: Invite-only personal agent used over iMessage/WhatsApp/SMS. Private beta since Feb 2026 (SiliconANGLE, WIRED); founder Noah Shinn's first public launch post was Aug 26, 2026, which is the date used here. Still invite-only.

name: Muse
note: Meta's personal AI agent (app 'Muse from Meta', WhatsApp, muse.ai), US launch Sep 8, 2026. Not the Muse Spark/Muse Code model family.

name: Grok Bot
note: Desktop/iOS app of always-on 'Bots' with their own cloud computer; beta launched Aug 11, 2026 (date per VentureBeat and Bloomberg; the x.ai post itself is undated). Sold via SuperGrok and Cursor plans.

name: Cue
note: Standalone personal-agent app from Manus, launched with Manus 2.0 on Sep 28, 2026; each agent gets its own email, phone number, wallet and computer. Invite-code early access (code MEETCUE).

name: dots
note: Always-on agents inside ChatGPT (official name 'dots', lowercase; 'Dots' in headlines), powered by GPT-6 Astra; rolled out Sep 29, 2026 to Pro and Business Premium.
